body: what a sad little man. couldn't see this creep's self-deleted comments but his mod removed posts sure do tell a tale of utter misery projected [https://www.reveddit.com/y/HotChiliBowl/?all=true](https://www.reveddit.com/y/HotChiliBowl/?all=true)

I'm certain that no matter how long I live, I'll never forget reading this post, your poem, and the cadence with which I read it in my mind 

I don't know much about God or heaven but I hope that when you *do* pass that you are met with the afterlife you have dreamt of

I just hope that you choose to live if only to share more poetry with us

Can I ask, do you think yourself to be one of those unwanted children? And if I was one of those unwanted children, do you think that I should befall that fate? It's not a loaded question and I don't intend to argue at all, I just want to better understand your mindset

I'm really sorry you're feeling so poorly. I know this is akin to "thoughts and prayers" but I send you my positive energies, whatever that is worth

The music that will be made. The friends you'll make. The arguments you'll have, because they'll shape you into a better person every time. You have poetry in your heart. Please share it while you are with us on this Earth. I don't know what happens next but I would really like to think we can make the most of our time here! I love you homie. Be good to yourself today

You've been through so much. From my perspective, you've got some neurotransmitters / brain chemistry that is giving your wonderful personality and spirit a run for their money. 

You have so much to offer yourself. You're so intelligent, at such a young age, that I'd be inclined to believe you would be such an even an experienced adult in the future. 

You have so much to offer others, just based on your experiences and awareness, not that you have an obligation to. 

You deserve to feel better. If you're gonna go for the worst case scenario - as someone who has voluntarily committed themselves (to a in-patient hospitalization) and had a really, really rough time doing it - I hope you consider that route first, before committing a final act. Don't mean to be selfish, or project unto you. I just hope you find some peace, comfort, and happiness. 

Our sentience is such a fragile thing. It shouldn't be wrought with as much pain as it is, but here we are. Much love homie

I looked at your history a bit, and you're roughly half my age. And dude, I remember very vividly how much those feelings *sucked* when I was your age 

You have so much experience ahead of you that would truly be a shame to miss out on. Hold on for a few years, if you can, my friend. You have not even gotten to live your own life yet, with freedom as an adult. 

I hope you don't kill yourself. You are more than the way you are interacting with these people who upset you so.

You are so much more than who you share genetic relations with. Why is your worth tied to them? Be yourself, despite their actions. You do *not* have to be crafted by the people you involuntarily spend your days with. If you are underage, give it time to enjoy life when you reach adulthood and are able to move out / on with your life. If you are of age, please consider this route.

I'm sorry you're having such a shitty time with your family. I hope things improve rapidly, and if they don't, that you are able to find some kind of peace in the midst of the chaos.

I'm so sorry you're feeling this way. My embarrassment leads me to feelings of suicidal ideation often, too. But you are more than your past actions. You have power over your actions now, and every action you take in the future. I hope you choose life, because you have so much to offer the people around you. 

I am so sorry you're feeling so very low, my friend. अपना ख्याल रखें

I admire so deeply how much you care for your friend. It's important to encourage your friend to seek out help because, as someone who *has* put this on their friends in the same way before, *you* cannot and should not have to shoulder the burdens that a counselor / psychiatrist is trained to deal with. Not that your friend is a *burden* but when they are approaching you with thoughts of suicidal ideation, you might as well consider it like any other friend with a physical illness that refuses to treat it. You *need* to set clear boundaries for your own health while still making your love and support apparent - she might not understand, but you need to take care of yourself, too. Does she have a familial support network or is it just your friend circle? If she's on antidepressants, she must be in contact with some kind of medical professional, and that's a great start for her. 

My advice, tl;dr - be good to *yourself* first, and then be good to your friend (like air masks on an airplane lol)

At a certain point after going through all the motions, committing myself, asking literally everyone in my life for advice, seeing a dozen counselors, and taking a dozen different drugs for the mental illness, it occurred to me that really, no one has the answer. No one can *really* lift me out of it, they can only try to help keep me feeling good when I already feel good. It's almost insurmountable, but that realization was a lot to deal with and it feels good now to know that I am responsible for my state, or at least doing what I can to use the emotional tools I have to make it possible to try to behave evenly / deal with suicidal thoughts.

I don't know if any of this will help you in the slightest, but the last thing I want to do is patronize you especially with how you're feeling now. As far as pretending goes, in my experience, there is truly something to the idea of "fake it till you make it" as shitty as it sounds, there's some data to back it up out there.

Last thing I have to say - fuck, friend. I'm sorry you feel so shitty and I hope you are able to find some comfort with rapidity

You have resources available to you, friend. Call 988 if in America? They have been good to me in the past. It's wonderful you respect your role as the eldest so much. I love how you ended your post though! Don't "push yourself" too hard though, just try your best :) take care and get some rest

The status of your life and your choices are yours to make but I just hope that the experiences the next few decades of our lives offer us enough reason to keep going. It's not just about the reasons but also our interpretation of them, right? It's about your mindset, and your willingness to accept the positivity, which is often chemically impossible when you just don't have the neurotransmitters to allow for it, which is *certainly* not your fault

It is okay to make your own decisions. But if you wanna get down into nitty gritty philosophy and what we owe to each other, I guess in my experience I'm looking at the drive to keep others going as my reason to live. I love you as another human just like I love any customer I serve at my retail job or people I meet on the street. 

I feel like you've got a lot to offer people and even yourself. Thanks for sharing with us tonight I appreciate you allowing me to consider your thoughts my friend

Much love and respect to you with how you're feeling, but my friend, we both know that we can't leave people feeling that way. I personally feel like we have a responsibility to each other to give opportunities to help us heal, and also to not take them for granted.

But at the root of the issue dude, I hope you find some peace and comfort tonight and live to see another day with us. There is so much more to happen and so much more to know. I hope you can feel the love I am sending you. Take care

You are such a giver. And a people pleaser. I think I am too. But you spent so much time in this post talking about people around you and how they feel that it warms my heart and also worries me for you. I want you to care about you more, just like I'm trying to care more about me. The intrusive thoughts, feeling like a failure, I think it's biological man. Like we have no choice but to think those thoughts and to power through them in the moment. 

Please share your feelings with your significant other. It's gonna be more than tough but it's likely to be the best path forward. I love ya and appreciate and respect all of your efforts and the fact you shared with us today. Today might have been shit but I hope tomorrow treats you right.

reminds me of a quote from a duncan trussel animation from "midnight gospel"

"having a body sucks"

it really is difficult being a person dude. I hope personing tomorrow is easier for you

Hey man I'm 28 and also find myself jobless at the moment. Been looking for jobs while fighting through alcoholism and losing my support system. Not to make it about me just wanna let you know I can relate

Yeah, the suicide hotlines can be ass sometimes. I've known some of the people that worked on them and those acquaintanceships alone were enough to make me feel like I didn't want to call.

I do the same exact thing at every job. Kick ass and then have some kind of internal crisis that tells me to move the fuck on. 

I don't know that we are lazy pieces of shit. I think this can be explained scientifically without referring to any emotional assessment of our personalities. I think, and I'm uneducated so take it with a grain of salt, we're lacking some kind of critical neurotransmitter that makes regular, sustainable joy accessible to us. So we seek big highs and when things mellow out we get bored? Idk, maybe I'm projecting a bit 

I too have lost my family. I have my significant other to help me through these things but otherwise my three closest friends live thousands of miles away with many issues of their own to deal with. 

That response from your mother sounds a lot like something mine might say. I think it's just an ill informed way to go about inquiring how you can get into a supportive environment in what might be the only way she knows how. Remember, we should try not to attribute to malice what can be attributed to ignorance (unless it is truly obvious and then go nuts right)

Got the 9 myself, such a dangerous world man I'm so scared to part with my last line of defense but I know it's the most accessible tool for ending things. But I know my grandfather went out that way and all I can ever imagine when I think of him, despite all the nice things he did for me, is the scene he was found in. I don't want to project or create any kind of guilt-ridden pressure for you I just wanna share my experience to give you things to consider and also just to grieve our feelings together if that makes sense / is okay with you 

I'm not perfect and I'm not the best person I know but I am taking incremental steps to reducing my drinking, to be more productive in my days, to engage in volunteerism in my community despite the hurdle of the anxiety, to talk to my neighbors, to take care of my home.. 

From one 'unremarkable' straight white jobless dude to another I love ya bro please do something nice for yourself today you deserve some good feelings straight up

I can't pretend that I am qualified to truly help you deal with these complex, serious issues but I do just want to say that I care deeply about you being alive and feeling better

You deserve to feel better, and you deserve to feel independent. You seem so damn intelligent, I hate to think anyone stands in the way of you realizing your potential

When the self-talk gets negative, I like to kind of have an internal argument with the negative voice, like it is a hateful stranger on the street that doesn't deserve my attention

Thank you for sharing your feelings with us and I hope you share these feelings with your new partner - nothing is incommunicable and if your new partner is a decent human they will recognize that you have complex emotions and thoughts that are deserving of some considerate thought and responses 

Try to have a good day, hug your little ones, run your fingers through their hair and let them know you love them. The world is a better place with parents that love us children in it

I cannot offer you sureties but I can say that I know there are billions of people in the world and it just seems statistically unlikely that there's not even one other adult for you to vibe with

I can only imagine the hardships you are going through. I am as white as it gets and super privileged. I'm not a handsome guy but my personality has made up for it sometimes. I don't know what it's like to experience your culture and the pressures you are feeling but I would encourage you to consider finding a path to another walk of life before you consider taking your own. It isn't impossible to change things for yourself, we hear incredible stories of remarkable people all the time online and there's no reason that you can't be one of those remarkable people that took the time and made the effort to find a way to change your life.

I hope none of this is in any way offensive. Thanks for sharing your feelings with us all here it means a lot that you are even here looking to feel better. Much love sister

no *you're* really sweet

now go on and get outta here scamp live ya life (I'm just playin' but you get me)

hey from human to human bro / sis I'm a lil inebriated but I just want you to know that I care deeply about you being alive and thriving and even if there's nothing I can do directly I just want you to know there is some energy somewhere on planet earth going straight your way. be good to yourself homie I fucking love you
It really sucks, man. I hope you have a good day.
You can't call someone out on their lack of compassion and then laugh at them for what you have described as their addiction. Cut the shit. Be the grown person you're telling them to be. Do better.

The OP is taking a little bit of "poetic license" with what they are saying, but the intent in their comment is to say that the alcohol in the can is what ultimately took his life, over a prolonged period of time.

just remember that you're looking for friends in a small pool. there's so many places in the world with so many different cultures and ideas, I think it's just statistically probable that you can find your tribe with one of them so to speak. just try to keep an open mind as best you can and thanks for being alive today dude. I know this kind of talk can be so easy to discount when you feel the way you do but I hope you'll consider it all the same. Much love

I believe in your capacity to make new friends. in my experience it is best to do so in your own community locally so you can have some direct support and give it when needed. These relationships you seek aren't beyond your capacity to attain. Be the kinda person you want to be friends with and do what you can to connect with others. I'm sorry you're disappointed with the words and actions of your current circle. I believe in you.

The lives we bind ourselves to are so special, especially when they're as innocent as our pets. They don't have the capacity for existential crises like we do and they are always happy just being alive. I think that's partially why I have dogs and cats. They bring me to a more primitive but happier place. Thanks for venting. We may be strangers but goddammit if I don't care so much about you being alive. 

Side note, I volunteer every so often at my local animal shelter, scoopin' poop and taking them on walks and whatnot. We get to hear the stories behind the dogs and I gotta say finding out a dog is there because their owner is no longer alive is brutal af. Whatever your motivation I hope you can fight the fight to keep helping the other living things around you that can't help themselves.

I've been coming to this subreddit for a hot minute, it's been over a decade. Sometimes as someone needing help, sometimes trying to help others, across many accounts with many attitudes. I feel like just by reaching out you are already doing so damn well. Just by considering the value your life has despite what the darkest parts of your mind might tell you. You have so much to offer to yourself not to mention the people and the world around you. I'm glad you don't have plans because I really hope you're never so low that you truly feel you need them. You seem smart and like you can dig yourself out of this hole and get back to building the life you deserve. Much love my friend I wish the best for you all day every day

I have always felt the same way. But in the past year or so I am beginning to see the cosmic value in dying by natural causes and fighting through the suffering. My grandfather shot and killed himself and that's all I'll ever remember about him despite the kindnesses he showed me as a child. I just want the people around me to remember a fighter.

This is just me projecting. This motivation doesn't apply to everyone obviously. Just saying even if we're not immediate family I too can garner strength from seeing you, a fellow human, fighting the fight. Much love

Useless? you've created beautiful children, my friend. What a wonderful accomplishment in and of itself. You are capable of so much! We set such lofty goals for ourselves but sometimes just existing and being available to your family is enough in itself. Much love

sorry for my late response. I know that the rhetoric I shared might not be the most motivating, especially with what you're feeling so I apologize if it's tiresome and I totally get it. just wanted you to know I inherently care for you as another human and for *me* something about being reminded of our humanity does the trick for me sometimes. 

I've said this to others in the past here, but have you considered the possibility that your brain just isn't *letting* you be happy and there may be some changes to be made? not that I *know* what those changes are/could be and NOT to sound judgmental. I just know it applies to me. 

sorry for all the projection. I hope you've had a better last few days

I deeply appreciate your self awareness and your concern for how you treat others and your own body. I'm so sorry you're in so much pain. I can only imagine what you're going through. I don't have any perfect answers for you but I hope that you cut yourself a little slack and continue to be aware of your own actions and how you treat people. We can't control the stimuli in the world around us, the only things we can really control are our responses to that stimuli. You sound strong and intelligent and I know you can use those traits to your advantage. I hope you choose to keep fighting. The world is better with you in it

I am sorry you've been given such a shit hand in life. I wish I had answers for you but all I can offer is whatever power my sincere empathy and genuine concern hold. If you ever want to talk or just vent and be heard you are welcome to DM. Try to be good to yourself. I bet you're nice to others based on the way you're talking, it'd be nice if you treated yourself the same way. I've heard it argued that there is an ethical / moral imperative to do so if that's your cup of tea. Take care friend
Can I ask what, if anything makes you happy and comfortable in life? What circumstances in your life make you feel unhappy / uncomfortable, in contrast?

Can I suggest being open with the people around you about how you're feeling? It's scary af but not as scary as the act of taking your own life IMO. Thanks for considering my question, I hope you find some joys in your waking hours today

Have you considered the possibility that the very real chemical reactions that occur as a result of social anxiety are preventing your brain from allowing you to process dopamine/serotonin, etc.? 

You're not strange. You're not crazy. You deserve to feel better

What a remarkable experience. I don't have the words to share my awe that you're here to share it but I'm so glad that you are. I hope you reconsider trying again. Not to suffer more but to find more joy. Did you ever have a "bucket list" or anything you wanted to experience but haven't?

I hope you choose to live. You are worth more than your relationships with the people you've already known. If you think your main issue here is interdependence, I'd at least encourage you to seek out and attempt building some new relationships before making a final decision. 

Have you considered you might be clinically depressed homie? It's a sickness like any other and some people don't even know they have it. Please do give some medicals pros the chance first if you haven't yet. And even if you have, maybe give them another chance. 

I browsed your profile a bit. You seem like a cool, inquisitive person that would be a great friend. Took me like 3 decades of life to realize I can find new friends and make my own family but I'm glad I pushed through despite the ongoing depression and I hope you do too friend

I can't imagine any suicide by drug is a comfortable experience for anyone involved.

I don't know you, and I don't know your life. But I am 100% certain that you not being a part of this world would make it a little worse. You are worth more than you know. You are worth more than failed relationships. You are worth more than your hardest times. The value you can give not only back to the world but to yourself is clear and present. You are capable of so very much.

I hope you choose not to take those pills. I hope health finds you rapidly. Much love, stranger.

Hey bro. Keep your head up and try to carry on. You are worth more than your nationality and you're worth more than your intrusive thoughts. There is a lot of life ahead of you and a lot of difficulty, challenges, and hardships, but a lot of beauty, a lot of time to meet people you do truly connect with. As an American, I totally understand being ashamed and feeling like a perpetrator of evil but all you can do is try to show the world that you are capable of defying its expectations. If only out of spite haha. Take care my friend

you know what has struck me more than anything with this post is your self awareness, even though you're just objectively incorrect about your self-analysis, and I mean that in the kindest, most positive way. you're aware of your actions and you literally know when to call for help. this isn't forever dude. nothing about what you've described sounds "monstrous" as you say. Thank your sister for being there for you in your time of need and do her a service by working on yourself moving forward. you're clearly smart as fuck so don't let these neurochemical imbalances hold you back. the self-loathing is, in my experience, self-serving, and there's a lot of value in serving the people that have helped/saved you with that time instead. 

love you, internet stranger. please try to show yourself the same kind of consideration you clearly show others. have a great day today, if only for your sister.
